nodes.label: Missing Backend Endpoints Documentation
nodes.rationale: Primary document cataloguing admin panel features lacking backend API endpoints with full implementation guides, schemas, and roadmap.

nodes.label: Deep Analytics Feature
nodes.rationale: High-priority admin feature combining funnel, cohort, and engagement analytics requiring three missing GET endpoints.

nodes.label: Roles & Permissions Management
nodes.rationale: High-priority admin feature for RBAC requiring 7 CRUD endpoints across roles and permissions resources.

nodes.label: Audit Trail / Logs
nodes.rationale: Medium-priority admin feature for tracking admin actions with paginated listing, detail, and aggregate stats endpoints.

nodes.label: Email Templates Management
nodes.rationale: Medium-priority admin feature for transactional email template CRUD plus a test-send endpoint with templated variable substitution.

nodes.label: Navigation Configuration
nodes.rationale: Low-priority admin feature for dynamic navigation tree GET/PUT updates; document recommends config-file storage over database.

nodes.label: Coming Soon Page Management
nodes.rationale: Low-priority admin feature with GET/PUT endpoints over an in-memory config object holding pages map and maintenanceMode flag.

nodes.label: GET /admin/analytics/funnel
nodes.rationale: Missing endpoint returning registered/enrolled/attempted/completed/pro counts with conversion_rates map; routes through protect+admin middleware.

nodes.label: GET /admin/analytics/cohort
nodes.rationale: Missing endpoint returning cohorts grouped by YYYY-MM with week_1/week_2/week_4 retention percentages via SQL aggregation.

nodes.label: GET /admin/analytics/engagement
nodes.rationale: Missing endpoint returning DAU/WAU/MAU plus average session duration, tests per user, and questions per session.

nodes.label: GET /admin/roles
nodes.rationale: Missing list endpoint returning all admin_roles with user_count subquery aggregate, ordered by is_system DESC then name.

nodes.label: GET /admin/permissions
nodes.rationale: Missing list endpoint grouping admin_permissions by resource with array_agg of actions.

nodes.label: POST /admin/roles
nodes.rationale: Missing create endpoint that inserts a new admin_roles row and returns 201 with the new record.

nodes.label: PUT /admin/roles/:id
nodes.rationale: Missing update endpoint that returns 404 when role not found and 200 with the updated record on success.

nodes.label: DELETE /admin/roles/:id
nodes.rationale: Missing delete endpoint that refuses with 400 when the role is still assigned to any users, then performs hard delete.

nodes.label: GET /admin/audit-logs
nodes.rationale: Missing paginated list endpoint supporting filters for action, tableName, userId with LIMIT/OFFSET and a separate count query.

nodes.label: GET /admin/audit-logs/stats
nodes.rationale: Missing stats endpoint returning total/today/week/month counts plus top 10 actions and top 10 users in the last 30 days.

nodes.label: GET /admin/audit-logs/:id
nodes.rationale: Missing detail endpoint declared in the endpoint list but not implemented in the provided guide snippet.

nodes.label: POST /admin/email-templates
nodes.rationale: Missing create endpoint persisting name, subject, content, JSONB variables and is_active flag; defaults is_active to true.

nodes.label: PUT /admin/email-templates/:id
nodes.rationale: Missing update endpoint that updates email_templates columns including updated_at = NOW() and returns 404 on miss.

nodes.label: DELETE /admin/email-templates/:id
nodes.rationale: Missing delete endpoint performing hard delete on email_templates row by id.

nodes.label: POST /admin/email-templates/:id/test
nodes.rationale: Missing test-send endpoint that loads a template, replaces {{variable}} tokens in subject and content, then dispatches via an external email service.

nodes.label: GET /admin/coming-soon
nodes.rationale: Missing endpoint returning the in-memory comingSoonConfig object with pages map and maintenanceMode flag.

nodes.label: PUT /admin/coming-soon
nodes.rationale: Missing endpoint that shallow-merges request body into the in-memory comingSoonConfig and returns the merged object.

nodes.label: DeepAnalytics.jsx (admin frontend)
nodes.rationale: Frontend component that issues Promise.allSettled of three analytics GETs (funnel/cohort/engagement) on lines 20-23.

nodes.label: RolePermissionsManager.jsx (admin frontend)
nodes.rationale: Frontend component that fetches /admin/roles and /admin/permissions in parallel on lines 30-31.

nodes.label: AuditTrailManager.jsx (admin frontend)
nodes.rationale: Frontend component that fetches /admin/audit-logs and /admin/audit-logs/stats with query string filters on lines 28-29.

nodes.label: EmailTemplatesManager.jsx (admin frontend)
nodes.rationale: Frontend component referenced as the consumer of the email-templates endpoints; specific line numbers not provided.

nodes.label: NavigationManager.jsx (admin frontend)
nodes.rationale: Frontend component referenced as the consumer of the navigation configuration GET/PUT endpoints.

nodes.label: ComingSoonManager.jsx (admin frontend)
nodes.rationale: Frontend component referenced as the consumer of the coming-soon GET/PUT endpoints.

nodes.label: analytics.js (backend route)
nodes.rationale: Target backend route file for funnel/cohort/engagement handlers; imports express, protect+admin middleware, and pool from postgres-helpers.

nodes.label: admin-roles.js (backend route)
nodes.rationale: Target backend route file for role CRUD (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE) handlers.

nodes.label: audit-logs.js (backend route)
nodes.rationale: Target backend route file for paginated audit-logs list and stats aggregation handlers.

nodes.label: email-templates.js (backend route)
nodes.rationale: Target backend route file for email template CRUD plus the test-send handler with {{variable}} token replacement.

nodes.label: coming-soon.js (backend route)
nodes.rationale: Target backend route file for coming-soon GET/PUT using an in-memory module-level config object.

nodes.label: protect middleware (auth.middleware.js)
nodes.rationale: Authentication middleware imported from ../../middleware/auth.middleware.js and used on every missing admin route.

nodes.label: admin middleware (auth.middleware.js)
nodes.rationale: Authorization middleware chained after protect to restrict endpoints to admin-role users.

nodes.label: audit_logs table
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL table storing admin action audit records with JSONB before/after diffs, INET ip_address, and four supporting indexes.

nodes.label: admin_roles table
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL table for RBAC roles with JSONB permissions column, is_system flag, and seeded super_admin/content_manager/support rows.

nodes.label: admin_permissions table
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL table of (resource, action) tuples with UNIQUE constraint and seeded users/tests CRUD+export rows.

nodes.label: email_templates table
nodes.rationale: PostgreSQL table for transactional email templates with subject/content/variables (JSONB) and is_active soft-toggle.

nodes.label: users table (referenced)
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing users table referenced by analytics queries (role, has_pro_pass, created_at, last_active_at, role_id) and audit_logs FK.

nodes.label: enrollments table (referenced)
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing enrollments table used to compute enrolled count in funnel analytics via COUNT(DISTINCT user_id).

nodes.label: test_attempts table (referenced)
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing test_attempts table used for funnel attempt/completion counts and avg question_count.

nodes.label: user_activity table (referenced)
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing user_activity table driving DAU/WAU/MAU calculations over an activity_date column.

nodes.label: sessions table (referenced)
nodes.rationale: Pre-existing sessions table providing duration column for avg_session_duration in engagement analytics.

nodes.label: Funnel analytics response schema
nodes.rationale: Expected success/data envelope containing a funnel stage map (registered/enrolled/attempted_test/completed_test/pro_subscriber) and a conversion_rates percentage map.

nodes.label: Cohort analytics response schema
nodes.rationale: Expected response carrying an array of cohort records with YYYY-MM key plus users count and week_n_retention percentages.

nodes.label: Engagement analytics response schema
nodes.rationale: Expected response with DAU/WAU/MAU scalars and average session/tests/questions metric scalars.

nodes.label: Audit log response schema
nodes.rationale: Expected envelope with log array, before_data/after_data JSONB diffs, and pagination object (page, limit, total, totalPages).

nodes.label: Express Router per-resource pattern
nodes.rationale: Architectural pattern repeating across all backend guides: const router = express.Router(); default export with route handlers and protect+admin middleware chain.

nodes.label: { success, data } response envelope
nodes.rationale: Consistent JSON envelope convention used in every response: { success: bool, data: ... } with errors including a message field.

nodes.label: Promise.allSettled parallel fetch
nodes.rationale: Frontend pattern using Promise.allSettled to fire multiple adminAPI.apiClient.get calls in parallel without short-circuiting on a single failure.

nodes.label: Paginated list endpoint pattern
nodes.rationale: Pagination pattern using page/limit query params, offset = (page-1)*limit, parallel data+count queries, and a pagination response object.

nodes.label: {{variable}} template substitution
nodes.rationale: Email template rendering uses RegExp(`{{${key}}}`, 'g') replacement over both content and subject from a variables map.

nodes.label: protect+admin middleware chain on every admin route
nodes.rationale: Security decision to chain protect (authentication) followed by admin (role check) middleware on every route in every new router file.

nodes.label: In-memory coming-soon config (no DB)
nodes.rationale: Implementation decision to store comingSoonConfig in a module-level let binding rather than persisting to the database or config file.

nodes.label: Refuse role deletion when assigned to users
nodes.rationale: Referential integrity decision: deleting an admin_role first checks users.role_id usage and returns 400 if any assignment exists.

nodes.label: Seed default admin roles (super_admin/content_manager/support)
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap decision to seed three is_system=true roles with JSONB wildcard/pattern permission arrays.

nodes.label: Four audit_logs indexes (action/table/user/created)
nodes.rationale: Performance decision to create four indexes on audit_logs (action, table_name, user_id, created_at DESC) to support filter and ordering patterns.

nodes.label: Redis caching for analytics (5-15 min TTL)
nodes.rationale: Non-functional recommendation in the Notes section to cache analytics responses with Redis at 5-15 minute TTL.

nodes.label: Rate-limit the test-send email endpoint
nodes.rationale: Security/abuse mitigation recommendation to apply rate limiting to the email-templates test-send endpoint.

nodes.label: Use materialized views for complex analytics
nodes.rationale: Performance recommendation to use PostgreSQL materialized views for complex analytics queries.

nodes.label: postgres-helpers.js (pool)
nodes.rationale: Shared database module imported as { pool } from ../../infrastructure/database/postgres-helpers.js providing node-postgres pool.query.

nodes.label: adminAPI.apiClient
nodes.rationale: Admin panel HTTP client object exposing .get/.post/.put/.delete methods used to call all missing endpoints.

nodes.label: 4-week implementation roadmap
nodes.rationale: Project management plan grouping the six features into 4 weekly milestones: analytics+audit (W1), roles+auth (W2), content (W3), testing (W4).

nodes.label: Priority/Complexity/Time matrix
nodes.rationale: Estimation matrix rating each feature across priority, complexity, and hours, summing to 25-35 hours / 3-4 working days.
